hero.title: Create AI Voices
hero.subtitle: Veltrix Voice platform helps you turn any text into high-quality MP3 audio in seconds. Perfect for YouTube, TikTok, Audiobooks & Ads.

features.title: Why Choose Veltrix Voice?
features.card1_desc: Advanced deep learning models pronounce accurately with pauses, maintaining 99% natural emotional intonation like human voices.
features.card2_desc: Powerful Cloud Server system converts 1,000 characters of text into MP3 in less than 2 seconds.
features.card3_desc: Use the generated MP3 files for monetized YouTube and TikTok Ads projects without worrying about copyright infringement.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.a1: All audio files generated on Veltrix Voice belong entirely to you. You can use them freely on commercial videos for YouTube, TikTok, Facebook without copyright issues.
faq.q2: How does the daily character limit work?
faq.a2: Every free account is granted 2,000 characters daily. The character limit is automatically reset to 2,000 characters at 00:00 UTC daily.
